task.title: Keep it safe
task.shortdesc: Save a copy of your tree as a file, and keep it somewhere else too.

step.cmd: On the card for your tree, choose .

stepresult.p: A small box opens. It starts with the words and asks how to save your tree.

step.cmd: Choose how to save your tree.

choices.choice: saves everything in one file, with its pictures. Choose this one.
saves your tree as a family tree file, without pictures. Use it only for a program that cannot read GEDZIP. If asked which version, choose GEDCOM 7 unless that program is old.

step.cmd: In the Files screen, choose where to put the file, then choose .

result.p: You now have a copy. Make a new one after you add a lot. Keep one off your device too.
result.note: If you opened a file from another program, keeps its own copy. The file you chose does not change.
